notes.title: Steam Achievements and more !!!
notes.content:
Hello

We want to inform you that we made new patch do Hostile Dimension game. Now you can unlock 10 achievements. Also we have removed some bugs mainly in multiplayer mode. Next new thing is taking steam name as nickname in multiplayer mode so you dont need to write it all the time when you want play with friends :)

All the best
